Jon

A curious young conure who enjoys music, follows his foster from room to room, and needs a patient family to help him build trust.

Getting to know Jon

Jon is about 2 years old, we think, and while his foster has been working with him, he is still somewhat wary of hands. His new home should be ready to continue working with him on trust in a slow and respectful way.

Jon is fully flighted, and needs out of cage time daily to exercise and socialize. He does tend to follow his foster from room to room as they go about their day, so clearly, he is interested in interacting.

Daily care

Currently, Jon eats Zupreem natural pellets in the medium size. He is a pellet dunker, meaning that he will dip his pellets in his water before eating them, so his new home may need to change his water multiple times a day.

His ideal home

Jon will need consistent, confident, and plentiful interaction with his new human flock to become more trusting of people. If you have the time, Jon is ready to charm you with his sweet little face.

Cage requirements

Jon does not come with a cage of his own. His adoptive family will need to supply one that is clean and of an appropriate size for conures: 32 inches wide by 23 inches deep, with 1/2 to 3/4 inch bar spacing. Please do not purchase a cage before you are approved to adopt Jon.
